name: go2_walk
title: Go2 walk (residual PPO on a model-based trot)
summary: The Unitree Go2 walks straight and durably via a residual PPO policy on a model-based trot (a foot-sphere-on-calf retarget ghost). The first quadruped skill in the library -- proof the interface spans robot CLASSES, not just humanoids. Quadruped ghosts use the .npz research lineage (research/shadowing/ghosts/), a different serialization than the humanoid json luts (the ghost_lut.py schema does not validate npz); the manifest flags the format so the catalogue is honest.

ghost.notes: The go2 walk ghost is GENERATED (foot-sphere-on-calf trot retarget) by research/shadowing/generate_go2_walk.py, not a stored file. Quadruped ghosts otherwise use the .npz lineage under research/shadowing/ghosts/ (a different serialization than the humanoid json luts).

baton.notes: Cross-robot cataloguing; not blended with the g1 family.

train.notes: Quadruped locomotion is deliberately RL (a measured deterministic trot drifts; the residual does nearly all propulsion). See docs/developer/spot-residual-rl.md + rl-current-state.md.

deploy.notes: Controller + policy baked into the world; `skill_lib.py run go2_walk` launches it.
